mechanism: load_position() handles a JSON syntax error with a logged fallback but returns any other valid JSON as is, so a position file that is a list, null or has a missing or mistyped field raises on every run and is never rewritten.
why_unseen: The finding was a dict of timestamps in a hook's announcement file that failed on .items() and fromisoformat; this is an inode and byte-offset cursor of a log tailer that fails on subscripting and comparison, and the control checks the shape and takes the same fallback.
